meaning: Selected affected requirements; all other canonical targets remain retained. No original owner or acceptance ID is reassigned.

requirements.name: Cumulative scope
requirements.statement: Retain every prior branch; additions do not replace earlier targets.

requirements.name: Draft versus send
requirements.statement: Drafting is distinct from sending email or performing other external writes.

requirements.name: Cross-device continuity
requirements.statement: Phone, desktop, Watch and glasses refer to the same authorized conversation/task.

requirements.name: Voice and interruption
requirements.statement: Distinguish stop speech, cancel task, stop investigation and request physical recovery.

requirements.name: Away/offline behavior
requirements.statement: Explain which functions work when away from home, WAN down or desktop asleep.

requirements.name: Two independent users
requirements.statement: Eric and Kennedy have independent private identities and stores.

requirements.name: Explicit household sharing
requirements.statement: Shared context is intentionally granted, not everything on the shared server.

requirements.name: Per-purpose consent
requirements.statement: Read, retain, summarize, share, cloud transmit and emergency disclose are separate grants.

requirements.name: Revocation and deletion
requirements.statement: Apply changes to pending jobs, caches, summaries and documented backups.

requirements.name: Audience-aware output
requirements.statement: Shared speakers/displays do not leak private information.

requirements.name: Device identity
requirements.statement: Borrowed/lost/swapped devices do not inherit another person's authority.

requirements.name: No employer imports
requirements.statement: Personal system does not import workplace/customer data or credentials by association.

requirements.name: Prompt-injection isolation
requirements.statement: Untrusted documents/images/audio/memory/tool descriptions cannot add authority.

requirements.name: Honest admin threat
requirements.statement: Do not equate application scopes with privacy from the host administrator.

requirements.name: EC120 unknown
requirements.statement: Run independent four-hour docs-only research; no inferred programmability.

requirements.name: Actual outcome and replay
requirements.statement: Distinguish ACK, observation and unknown; reconcile before retry.

requirements.name: Payload platform choice
requirements.statement: Choose ground/consumer/open/enterprise path based on actual payload need.

requirements.name: Simulator protection
requirements.statement: Preserve current Gen0 pins, namespaces and milestone separation.

requirements.name: Three communication levels
requirements.statement: Separate offline local portal, low-bandwidth relay and real internet.

requirements.name: Public guest isolation
requirements.statement: Easy access does not expose personal/health/control/admin systems.

requirements.name: Backhaul qualification
requirements.statement: Use verified cellular/satellite/ground upstream when available.

requirements.name: Mesh as question
requirements.statement: Choose star/mesh/point-to-point links based on measured need.

requirements.name: Message truthfulness
requirements.statement: Track storage/relay/destination/recipient acknowledgements distinctly.

requirements.name: Data ferry
requirements.statement: Explore store-and-forward robot mobility separately from permanent connectivity.

requirements.name: Power and offline operation
requirements.statement: Measure ground station endurance and restart behavior.

requirements.name: Opt-in community support
requirements.statement: Shared relays/observations expose only explicit capabilities.

requirements.name: Independent help
requirements.statement: Emergency communication does not wait for AI/drone/printer/cloud budgets.

requirements.name: Standing incapacitation target
requirements.statement: Preserve separately reviewed preauthorized dispatch simulation.

requirements.name: Healthcare communication
requirements.statement: Prepare minimal consented facts and location/timestamps for a helper.

requirements.name: Kit logistics
requirements.statement: Explore delivery/access to predefined supplies with human factors.

requirements.name: Fire/rescue lights
requirements.statement: Explore bright lights, speakers and active illumination.

requirements.name: Professional deployment gate
requirements.statement: Separate simulation ambition from real fireground/medical/aviation permission.

requirements.name: Readiness first
requirements.statement: Prepare qualified equipment before a crisis rather than fabricate during one.
